main_text.p: CAeterum Petrus & Iohannes simul ascendebant in templum sub horam precationis nempe nonam.
2 Quidam autem vir claudus ab vtero matris suae portabatur: quem ponebant quotidie ad portam templi quae dicitur speciosa, vt peteret eleemosynam ab iis qui ingrediebantur in templum, &c. ad ver. 9.

page.notes: Initial V of "Voniam" is a decorated woodcut initial; first word read as Voniam (likely Quoniam). Several marginal notes at the right are partly cut off; the left-margin note reads "Incremen-". Doubtful: "{q}" marks a printed paragraph number 2 in the margin area; catchword none.
